_notes: E2 R1.2: what the bishops' conference issues (systems/conference.ts). Titles are invented and are none of the conference's real documents; gists and changes are in the register of the real ones. Each assembly (June and November; the cadence and the three-year offices are custom to verify against the current statutes) the conference issues one of these at CONFERENCE.documentChance, weighted by the fit of its temper to the document's lean, not again inside its years, the voting guide only in a presidential election year. A document comes to a priest as his bishop's letter with the bishop's own reading (norm) and, some weeks later, as a scene at home (beat conference, scene cascade) that asks what he will do with it; a player-bishop votes on it at the assembly (scene assembly). It moves no law: its axis is conference:<topic> and the policies of Rome's axes are untouched. Leans, years, and the chance are invented and flagged.

documents.title: Bread and Work
documents.gist: on the economy and the poor
documents.change: Every parish is asked to read it in the pulpit over three Sundays and to name what the poor of its own town need.
letter: The conference has issued a pastoral letter, Bread and Work, on the economy and the poor: wages, work, and what the Church owes the man who has neither.
It is to be read from the pulpit over three Sundays in Ordinary Time, and every parish is asked to say, in a page to the chancery, what the poor of its own town need most.
documents.line: the pastoral letter on the economy

documents.title: The Stranger at the Gate
documents.change: The parishes are asked to keep their doors open to the undocumented, to say so from the pulpit, and to know a lawyer.
letter: The conference has issued a statement, The Stranger at the Gate, on immigration: the Church's doors are open to the undocumented, its pulpits will say so, and its parishes should know a lawyer.
It was not unanimous, and the vote is in the papers.

documents.title: One Blood
documents.change: Each parish is to hold an evening on the letter before Lent, and the diocese will ask who came.
letter: The conference has issued a pastoral letter, One Blood, on racism: the sin, the history, and the parish as the place it is unlearned.
Each parish is to hold an evening on it before Lent. The diocese will ask who came.

documents.title: Words for the Altar
documents.gist: on the translation of the liturgy
documents.change: The new translations of the rites are to be used from the first Sunday of Advent, and the old books put away.
letter: The conference has approved new translations of the rites, Words for the Altar, closer to the Latin and harder on the tongue.
They are to be used from the first Sunday of Advent. The old books are to be put away, not given away.
documents.line: the new translations of the rites

documents.title: Conscience and the Ballot
documents.gist: on the duties of a Catholic voter
documents.change: The guide is to be in the vestibule by October, and a homily on conscience is asked for; no candidate is to be named from the pulpit.
letter: The conference has reissued its guide for voters, Conscience and the Ballot, with a new introduction that half the bishops wanted and the other half signed.
It is to be in the vestibule by October, and a homily on conscience is asked for. No candidate is to be named from the pulpit, and the diocese means it.

documents.title: A Liberty Older Than the Republic
documents.change: A fortnight of prayer for religious liberty is asked for in June, with a holy hour in every parish.
letter: The conference has issued a statement, A Liberty Older Than the Republic, on religious liberty and the laws that press on it.
A fortnight of prayer is asked for in June, with a holy hour in every parish and the statement read at it.

documents.title: the revised norms for the protection of minors
documents.gist: revising the norms for the protection of minors
documents.change: Every parish is to be audited under the revised norms within the year, and every volunteer trained again.
letter: The conference has revised the norms for the protection of minors: the audit, the training, the reporting, and the review board, each tightened.
Every parish is to be audited within the year and every volunteer trained again. The chancery will send the dates.

documents.title: This Is My Body
documents.change: A three-year revival of Eucharistic devotion is opened: adoration, processions, and preaching on the Real Presence in every parish.
letter: The conference has issued a pastoral letter, This Is My Body, on the Eucharist, and opened a three-year revival to go with it.
Every parish is asked for adoration weekly, a procession on Corpus Christi, and preaching on the Real Presence through the year.
documents.line: the pastoral letter on the Eucharist

documents.title: The Household of God
documents.change: Marriage preparation is lengthened to a year, and the parishes are asked to preach on the letter in the autumn.
letter: The conference has issued a pastoral letter, The Household of God, on marriage and the family.
Marriage preparation is to be a year long from now on, and the parishes are asked to preach on the letter through the autumn.
documents.line: the pastoral letter on the family

documents.title: Listening Together
documents.change: Every parish is to hold listening sessions this year and send what it heard, unedited, to the diocese.
letter: The conference has issued guidelines, Listening Together, for the listening sessions Rome asked for.
Every parish is to hold them this year, with a facilitator who is not the pastor, and send what it heard to the diocese unedited.
documents.line: the guidelines for the listening sessions

documents.title: The Land Is the Lord's
documents.change: The parishes are asked to preach on creation in September, to audit their buildings, and to say what they will change.
letter: The conference has issued a statement, The Land Is the Lord's, on the care of creation.
The parishes are asked to preach on it in September, to look at their own buildings, and to tell the diocese what they will change.

documents.title: Daughters of the Church
documents.gist: on women in the life of the Church
documents.change: Every parish and diocesan council is to have women on it by the year's end, and to say who.
letter: The conference has issued a statement, Daughters of the Church, on women in the life of the Church: the councils, the ministries open to them, the offices.
Every parish and diocesan council is to have women on it by the year's end, and to say who.
documents.line: the statement on women in the Church

documents.title: Before the Altar
documents.change: Silence before Mass, the posture at Communion, and the music are addressed; the parishes are asked to read the guidelines with their musicians.
letter: The conference has issued guidelines, Before the Altar, on reverence at Mass: silence before it, the posture at Communion, the music and what it is for.
The parishes are asked to read them with their musicians and their sacristans, and to say nothing about them from the pulpit that the guidelines do not say.
documents.line: the guidelines on reverence at Mass
